summary: The StaffRecognitionActivity system manages staff recognition activities within an organization. It supports adding, updating, deleting, and searching for recognition activities associated with specific staff members.
purpose: Manage the life cycle of staff recognition activities, including creation, modification, retrieval, and deletion.

workflows.name: Add Staff Recognition Activity
steps: Enter Staff ID, Activity Type Code ID, Academic Appointment Type Code ID, Activity Type Comments, Activity Date, Expiry Date, Department ID, and Program ID.

workflows.name: Search Staff Recognition Activity by Staff ID
steps: System retrieves and returns matching entries.

conditions: Use alternate language fields if available when retrieving descriptions.
system_behavior: The system retrieves details from the database when adding or updating activities.
The system executes stored procedures for database operations.
